infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Rangla Punjab Restaurant does not use your location. Delivery addresses are typed in by you.

plugins.microphonePermission: Rangla Punjab Restaurant does not record audio. The app only plays a short sound when a new order arrives.

plugins.photosPermission: The app uses your photos so you can attach a picture when you report a problem with an order.
plugins.cameraPermission: The app uses the camera so you can photograph a problem with your order instead of describing it.
